question: A rigid electric dipole of moment $p$ is placed in a uniform electric field $E$ and can rotate about its center. Identify the equilibrium orientation(s) and their stability. Give reason.

options.A: θ = 0° is stable and θ = 180° is unstable — because U(θ) = −pE cosθ has a minimum at 0° and a maximum at 180°.
options.B: θ = 0° and θ = 180° are both stable — because the torque τ = pE sinθ is zero at both.
options.C: θ = 90° is stable — because the dipole experiences no net force in a uniform field.
options.D: No orientation is an equilibrium — because the dipole always experiences a nonzero torque in a uniform field.
